name: SD: City housing (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A city's housing market, every week: permit applications in review, homes under construction, homes for sale, homes under contract, occupied homes, homes demolished or abandoned, and the households out house hunting. The data is generated by a system dynamics model of the market (the ground truth is in sd-housing/truth.model.json, including a stage the city's figures do not show), so discovery can be checked exactly. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
